requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Reduce the number of reference names for the HP OJP 9010 series on 123.hp.com to a single, consistent name to minimize user confusion and errors.

requirements.Requirement: Printer able to run all new/current EM / market segment media
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Printer must reliably print on all new and current EM (Evaluation Media) and market segment media types, meeting intervention specifications for different regions and climatic conditions.

requirements.Requirement: Product can be placed and work on uneven surface ( sofa , table cloth , carpet …)
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Printer must function correctly and without mechanical failure when placed on uneven surfaces such as sofas, table cloths, or carpets.

requirements.Requirement: Tilt left and right each while printing
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Assess whether the printer continues to function without failure when tilted 20 degrees left or right during printing.

requirements.Requirement: Put printer on trolley and print
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Printer must maintain print quality and function correctly when printing while placed on a moving trolley.
